integrity: Proof and explicit reproducible finite computation are provided. Self-review passed correctness, originality and value; no independent audit or priority certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns constant-input fourth moments/additive energy only, not the optimal L2-to-L4 extension operator norm; characteristics 2,3,5 excluded. The smooth case retains elliptic traces and a finite correction; historical equivalence in older monomial-curve or split-Jacobian literature is a residual priority risk.
title: Elliptic-trace fourth moments and a characteristic-eleven jump for the sixth-power graph
